records.name: slide.slide.partner.view.search
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <search string="Attendees">
                <field name="partner_id"/>
                <field name="slide_id"/>
                <field name="channel_id"/>
                 <separator/>
                <filter string="Completed" name="filter_completed" domain="[('completed', '=', True)]"/>
                <group>
                    <filter string="Content" name="groupby_slide_id" context="{'group_by': 'slide_id'}"/>
                </group>
            </search>
        </field>

records.name: slide.slide.partner.view.list
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <list string="Attendees" create="0" delete="0">
                <field name="create_date" string="Accessed on"/>
                <field name="partner_id"/>
                <field name="slide_id" optional="hide"/>
                <field name="channel_id" optional="hide"/>
                <field name="completed" readonly="1"/>
                <field name="quiz_attempts_count" readonly="1" string="# Quizz Attempts" sum="# Total Attempts"/>
                <field name="vote" readonly="1" sum="# Likes"/>
            </list>
        </field>

records.name: slide.slide.partner.view.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form string="Attendee" create="0">
                <sheet>
                    <group col="2" name="main_content">
                        <group>
                            <field name="partner_id"/>
                            <field name="slide_id"/>
                            <field name="slide_category" invisible="1"/>
                            <field name="channel_id"/>
                        </group>
                        <group>
                            <field name="completed" readonly="1"/>
                            <field name="quiz_attempts_count" readonly="1"/>
                            <field name="vote" readonly="1"/>
                        </group>
                    </group>
                </sheet>
            </form>
        </field>

records.name: slide.slide.partner.view.search.inherit.survey
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <xpath expr="//filter[@name='filter_completed']" position="after">
                <filter string="Certification Passed" name="filter_survey_scoring_success" domain="[('survey_scoring_success', '=', True)]"/>
            </xpath>
        </field>

records.name: slide.slide.partner.view.list.inherit.survey
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <xpath expr="//field[@name='completed']" position="after">
                <field name="survey_scoring_success" string="Certification Passed"/>
            </xpath>
        </field>

records.name: slide.slide.partner.view.form.inherit.survey
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <xpath expr="//field[@name='completed']" position="after">
                <field name="survey_scoring_success" readonly="1" invisible="slide_category != 'certification'"/>
            </xpath>
            <xpath expr="//group[@name='main_content']" position="after">
                <field name="user_input_ids" mode="list" readonly="1" invisible="slide_category != 'certification'"/>
            </xpath>
        </field>
